- [ ] **Step 17: Create the probe `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/sessions.mjs`** (git-ignored). It drives real PTY sessions of Task W1's fake agent through the harness Task U1 prepared; it stubs only Look only (the harness locks the gate on) with the server's own Look only answers, a missing terminal module, the login-shell notice, and Agent OS going away. Section 8 is this task's Review Focus 5 test (ruling R28).

```js
// Task U3: the Sessions page, the New session dialog, Stop, Resume, Dismiss, Terminal settings, and Look only while
// sessions are open (Review Focus 5).
// Run (after `npm run build`), from the worktree root:
//   node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/sessions.mjs
// It drives real PTY sessions on the throwaway server. The harness's fake-bin/ holds Task W1's shims (Task U1 put
// them there, ruling R17), so a session runs test/fakes/tui-agent.mjs: it prints "FAKE_ARGV {...}" and a "> "
// prompt, and answers each typed line with "you said: <text>". Page-level stubs (route) only for what the fakes
// cannot produce: Look only (the harness starts the server with the gate locked on) together with the server's
// own Look only answers (Tasks S6 and S8 test those for real), no terminal module, the login-shell notice, and
// Agent OS going away. Nothing here starts a real agent, and the probe stops every session it started.
import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const W = 1470, H = 956;
const BANNER = "FAKE_ARGV";
const LOOK_ONLY = "Safety is on Look only, so no session can start. Allow running agents in Safety, then try again.";
const LOOK_ONLY_GATE = {
  enabled: false, level: 0, source: "local-config", envLocked: false, localEnabled: false, dryRunDefault: true,
  updatedAt: null, updatedBy: null, reason: "", publicSummary: "Look only"
};
const LINK = "https://example.com/docs";
const json = (route, body, status = 200) => route.fulfill({ status, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
// Chrome logs every refused request (the folder policy's 400, the stubbed 409s, an aborted read) as "Failed to load
// resource". Those are expected here; anything else is a real console error.
const realErrors = (errors) => errors.filter((e) => !/Failed to load resource/.test(e));

export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail, api, BASE, HOME }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));
  if (!HOME) {
    fail("harness", "audit.mjs does not pass HOME to probes (Task U1 sets this up, ruling R17)");
    return;
  }
  const myApp = path.join(HOME, "projects", "my-app");
  const notes = path.join(HOME, "projects", "notes");
  // Only section 7b's Codex sessions use this folder, so the resume rules there see no other session (decision Q36).
  const shared = path.join(HOME, "projects", "shared");
  mkdirSync(myApp, { recursive: true });
  mkdirSync(notes, { recursive: true });
  mkdirSync(shared, { recursive: true });

  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const waitFor = async (fn, ms = 10000) => {
    const end = Date.now() + ms;
    while (Date.now() < end) {
      try { if (await fn()) return true; } catch {}
      await sleep(250);
    }
    return false;
  };
  // The DOM renderer (the default on macOS, decision Q45) keeps the screen's text in .xterm-rows.
  const termText = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.querySelector(".os-sess-term .xterm-rows")?.textContent || "");
  const sessionParam = (tab) => new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("session") || "";
  const selectedTab = (tab) => tab.locator('.os-sess-tabs [role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]');
  const tabNamed = (tab, name) => tab.getByRole("tab", { name, exact: true });
  const sideways = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth > document.scrollingElement.clientWidth);
  const dialogNamed = (tab, name) => tab.getByRole("dialog", { name });
  const focusText = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.textContent?.trim() || document.activeElement?.getAttribute("aria-label") || document.activeElement?.tagName || "");
  async function startThroughDialog(tab, agent, folder) {
    const dialog = dialogNamed(tab, "New session");
    await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.getByText("Checking your agents and safety level…").count()) === 0, 15000);
    await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: agent, exact: true }).click();
    if (folder !== null) await dialog.getByLabel("Folder (full path)").fill(folder);
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Start session" }).click();
    await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.count()) === 0, 25000);
    await waitFor(async () => sessionParam(tab) !== "", 5000);
    return sessionParam(tab);
  }
  async function stopSelected(tab, title) {
    await tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Session details" }).getByRole("button", { name: "Stop session" }).click();
    await dialogNamed(tab, `Stop ${title}?`).getByRole("button", { name: "Stop session" }).click();
    return waitFor(async () => /Ended · open recording/.test((await selectedTab(tab).textContent()) || ""), 15000);
  }
  async function stopEverything() {
    const answer = await api("GET", "/api/sessions?kind=all");
    for (const s of answer.json.sessions || []) if (s.status !== "exited") await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${s.id}/stop`);
  }

  try {
    // 1. No sessions yet: the designed empty state, its one primary button and the help link.
    {
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "sessions");
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
      check((await tab.locator("h1").first().textContent())?.trim() === "Sessions", "h1 reads Sessions");
      check(await tab.getByText("No sessions yet", { exact: true }).isVisible(), "empty state: No sessions yet");
      check(await tab.getByText("A session is an agent's own terminal, running in a folder you pick. It works the same as in Terminal.").isVisible(), "empty state: the decided body");
      check((await tab.locator(".os-sess .os-btn--primary").count()) === 1, "one primary button: New session");
      const link = tab.getByRole("link", { name: "How a session works" });
      check(await link.isVisible(), "link: How a session works");
      check((await link.getAttribute("href")) === "?page=help", "the link goes to the help page", await link.getAttribute("href"));
      const text = (await tab.locator(".os-sess").innerText()) || "";
      check(!/coming|arrives|later update|split/i.test(text), "no promises on the empty page", text.slice(0, 200));
      check(!(await sideways(tab)), "no sideways scroll (empty)");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "console clean (empty)", errors.join(" / "));
      await shot(tab, "sessions", W, H, "empty");
      await context.close();
    }

    // 2. The New session dialog in a browser tab: the agents, the typed folder, the server's folder policy, OpenClaw's
    //    folder, and a typed folder kept across a close.
    {
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "sessions");
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1000);
      const opener = tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" });
      await opener.click();
      const dialog = dialogNamed(tab, "New session");
      check(await dialog.isVisible(), "New session opens the dialog");
      check(await tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest('[role="dialog"]'))), "focus moves into the dialog");
      const names = (await dialog.getByRole("radio").allTextContents()).map((n) => n.trim());
      check(names.join() === "Claude Code,Codex,Cursor,Hermes,OpenClaw", "five agents in the prototype's order", names.join());
      check(await dialog.getByText("The agent opens in its own terminal inside Agent OS.").isVisible(), "the prototype's lede");
      const field = dialog.getByLabel("Folder (full path)");
      check(await field.isVisible(), "browser tab: a typed folder (full path)");
      check(await dialog.getByText("For example /Users/you/projects/my-app").isVisible(), "the decided hint");
      const startButton = dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Start session" });
      await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.getByText("Checking your agents and safety level…").count()) === 0, 15000);
      check(await startButton.isDisabled(), "Start session is off until a folder is typed");
      await field.fill("projects/my-app");
      check(await dialog.getByText("Type the full path, starting with / (or a drive letter on Windows).").isVisible(), "a relative path is explained before anything is sent");
      check(await startButton.isDisabled(), "and Start session stays off");
      // The server's folder policy: the home folder itself is refused, the words show under the field, the text stays.
      await field.fill(HOME);
      await startButton.click();
      const note = dialog.locator("#os-newsess-folder-note");
      check(await waitFor(async () => /home folder/i.test((await note.textContent()) || ""), 15000), "HOME is refused with the server's words under the field", await note.textContent());
      check((await field.inputValue()) === HOME, "the typed folder is kept after a refusal");
      check(await dialog.isVisible(), "the dialog stays open after a refusal");
      await shot(tab, "sessions", W, H, "dialog-refused");
      // OpenClaw: no folder field, the decided note.
      await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: "OpenClaw", exact: true }).click();
      check((await dialog.getByLabel("Folder (full path)").count()) === 0, "OpenClaw: no folder field");
      check(await dialog.getByText("OpenClaw picks its own folder for now.").isVisible(), "OpenClaw: the decided note");
      await shot(tab, "sessions", W, H, "dialog-openclaw");
      await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: "Claude Code", exact: true }).click();
      await dialog.getByLabel("Folder (full path)").fill(myApp);
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
      check((await dialog.count()) === 0, "Escape closes the dialog");
      check(/New session/.test(await focusText(tab)), "focus is back on New session", await focusText(tab));
      await opener.click();
      check((await dialogNamed(tab, "New session").getByLabel("Folder (full path)").inputValue()) === myApp, "a typed folder is still there when the dialog opens again");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "console clean (dialog)", errors.join(" / "));
      await context.close();
    }

    // 3-7. One live session through its whole life: start, type, Stop, Resume, Open recording, Dismiss.
    {
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "sessions");
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1000);
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).click();
      const id = await startThroughDialog(tab, "Claude Code", myApp);
      check(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(id), "after Start session the address names the new session", id);
      check(((await selectedTab(tab).textContent()) || "").trim() === "Claude Code · my-app", "the tab reads Claude Code · my-app", await selectedTab(tab).textContent());
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(BANNER), 15000), "the fake agent's own screen shows in the terminal", (await termText(tab)).slice(0, 120));
      check(await tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest(".xterm"))), "the new session's terminal has the keyboard");
      await tab.keyboard.type("hello");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes("you said: hello")), "typing reaches the agent and its answer comes back", (await termText(tab)).slice(-160));
      const panel = tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Session details" });
      check(((await panel.locator("h2").textContent()) || "").trim() === "my-app", "panel title is the folder name");
      check(/Claude Code/.test((await panel.locator(".os-sess-panel__agent").textContent()) || ""), "the panel names the agent");
      check(await waitFor(async () => /Live/.test((await panel.locator(".os-sess-panel__stat").textContent()) || ""), 8000), "state reads Live after the first output");
      const meter = panel.getByRole("region", { name: "Live meter" });
      const meterText = (await meter.textContent()) || "";
      for (const row of ["Brain", "Model", "Running for", "Context used"]) check(meterText.includes(row), `Live meter row: ${row}`, meterText);
      check(meterText.includes("— means unknown"), "the hint: — means unknown");
      check((await meter.locator(".os-sess-kv__dash").count()) >= 2, "unknown rows read —");
      check((await panel.evaluate((el) => Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().width))) === 336, "panel is 336 px wide at 1470");
      check(await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Stop session" }).isVisible(), "Stop session in the footer");
      check(await panel.getByText("Recorded").isVisible(), "Recorded in the footer");
      check((await tab.locator(".os-sess-keys").count()) === 0, "browser tab: no shortcut hints");
      check(/own terminal program/.test((await tab.locator(".os-sess__cap").textContent()) || ""), "caption under the terminal");
      await shot(tab, "sessions", W, H, "live");
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).click();
      const again = dialogNamed(tab, "New session");
      check(await waitFor(async () => await again.getByRole("group", { name: "Recent folders" }).getByRole("button", { name: "my-app" }).isVisible(), 8000), "Recent folders offers my-app");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");

      // 4. Stop asks first with the decided words; Keep it running changes nothing; Stop session ends it.
      await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Stop session" }).click();
      const stop = dialogNamed(tab, "Stop Claude Code · my-app?");
      check(await stop.isVisible(), "Stop asks first: Stop Claude Code · my-app?");
      check(await stop.getByText("This ends Claude Code in this tab. The recording stays in Runs.").isVisible(), "the decided Stop body");
      check((await focusText(tab)) === "Keep it running", "focus starts on Keep it running", await focusText(tab));
      await stop.getByRole("button", { name: "Keep it running" }).click();
      await tab.waitForTimeout(800);
      check(!/Ended/.test((await selectedTab(tab).textContent()) || ""), "Keep it running keeps it running");
      check(await stopSelected(tab, "Claude Code · my-app"), "the tab turns into Ended · open recording", await selectedTab(tab).textContent());
      const line = (await panel.locator(".os-sess-panel__line").textContent()) || "";
      check(/Stopped by you\./.test(line) && /The recording is in Runs\./.test(line), "panel: Stopped by you. The recording is in Runs.", line);
      check(/Ended/.test((await panel.locator(".os-sess-panel__stat").textContent()) || ""), "state reads Ended (ruling R26)");
      check((await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Stop session" }).count()) === 0, "an ended session has no Stop");
      check(await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" }).isEnabled(), "Resume conversation is offered (Claude Code resumes by id)");
      check(await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Open recording" }).isVisible(), "Open recording is offered");
      check((await tab.locator(".os-sess-term").count()) === 1 && (await termText(tab)).includes("you said: hello"), "the last screen stays readable after the session ends here");
      check(await tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement !== document.body), "focus did not fall to the page after Stop");
      await shot(tab, "sessions", W, H, "ended");

      // 5. Resume for real: the same tab and id, a fresh terminal.
      await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" }).click();
      const resume = dialogNamed(tab, "Resume Claude Code · my-app?");
      check(await resume.isVisible(), "Resume asks first: Resume Claude Code · my-app?");
      check(await resume.getByText(/starts Claude Code again in the same tab/).isVisible(), "the decided Resume body");
      check((await resume.getByText(/may be one you started outside Agent OS/).count()) === 0, "no fallback warning for Claude Code");
      await resume.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => !/Ended/.test((await selectedTab(tab).textContent()) || ""), 20000), "the same tab is open again");
      check(sessionParam(tab) === id, "the same session id after Resume");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(BANNER), 15000), "a fresh terminal shows the agent again");

      // 6. Open recording lands on Runs → Session recordings with that row asked for.
      check(await stopSelected(tab, "Claude Code · my-app"), "stopped again");
      await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Open recording" }).click();
      await tab.waitForTimeout(500);
      const url = new URL(tab.url());
      check(url.searchParams.get("page") === "runs" && url.searchParams.get("tab") === "recordings" && url.searchParams.get("highlight") === id, "Open recording: ?page=runs&tab=recordings&highlight=<id>", url.search);

      // 7. Dismiss hides the ended tab at once, is kept after a reload, and focus goes somewhere sensible.
      await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=sessions`);
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
      const dismiss = tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Dismiss Claude Code · my-app" });
      check(await dismiss.isVisible(), "the ended tab has Dismiss (×), named after it");
      await dismiss.click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Dismiss Claude Code · my-app" }).count()) === 0, 3000), "Dismiss hides the tab at once");
      check(await waitFor(async () => await tab.getByText("No sessions yet", { exact: true }).isVisible(), 8000), "with no tab left, the empty state is back");
      check(/New session/.test(await focusText(tab)), "focus goes to New session", await focusText(tab));
      await tab.reload();
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
      check(await tab.getByText("No sessions yet", { exact: true }).isVisible(), "dismissed stays dismissed after a reload");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "console clean (live flows)", errors.join(" / "));
      await context.close();
    }

    // 7b. Fallback resume (Codex, decision Q36; the words are Task U1's resumeConfirmCopy, the rules Task S6's): the
    //     Resume confirm's honest warning, then the written reason under a Resume that can't be pressed, first while
    //     another Codex session is open in the folder, then once two ended Codex sessions share it.
    {
      const FALLBACK_WARNING = "This resumes the most recent Codex conversation in this folder, which may be one you started outside Agent OS.";
      const OPEN_HERE = "Another Codex session is open in this folder. Stop it first.";
      const TWO_ENDED = "More than one ended Codex session used this folder, so Agent OS can't tell which conversation to resume.";
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "sessions");
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1000);
      const panel = tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Session details" });
      const resumeButton = panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" });
      const why = tab.locator("#os-sess-resume-why");
      // count() never waits, so a missing reason reads "" at once instead of holding the probe up.
      const whyText = async () => ((await why.count()) ? (await why.textContent()) || "" : "").trim();

      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).click();
      const firstId = await startThroughDialog(tab, "Codex", shared);
      await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(BANNER), 15000);
      check(await stopSelected(tab, "Codex · shared"), "fallback setup: the first Codex session ended", await selectedTab(tab).textContent());
      check(await waitFor(async () => await resumeButton.isEnabled(), 8000), "Codex alone in its folder: Resume conversation is offered");
      check((await why.count()) === 0, "and no reason is shown under it", await whyText());
      await resumeButton.click();
      const resume = dialogNamed(tab, "Resume Codex · shared?");
      check(await resume.isVisible(), "Resume asks first: Resume Codex · shared?");
      check(await resume.getByText(FALLBACK_WARNING, { exact: true }).isVisible(), "Codex: the Resume confirm warns it may be a conversation started outside Agent OS");
      await shot(tab, "sessions", W, H, "resume-fallback");
      await resume.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
      check((await resume.count()) === 0, "Cancel closes the Resume confirm");
      check(/Ended/.test((await selectedTab(tab).textContent()) || ""), "and the tab stays ended");

      // Another Codex session open in the same folder: Resume can't be pressed, and the panel says why.
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).click();
      const secondId = await startThroughDialog(tab, "Codex", shared);
      await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(BANNER), 15000);
      check(Boolean(firstId) && Boolean(secondId) && firstId !== secondId, "fallback setup: a second Codex session in the same folder", `${firstId} ${secondId}`);
      await tabNamed(tab, "Codex · shared · Ended · open recording").click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => sessionParam(tab) === firstId, 3000), "the first (ended) Codex tab is picked again", sessionParam(tab));
      check(await waitFor(async () => await resumeButton.isDisabled(), 8000), "another Codex session open in the folder: Resume conversation is off");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await whyText()) === OPEN_HERE, 8000), `the panel says: ${OPEN_HERE}`, await whyText());
      check((await resumeButton.getAttribute("aria-describedby")) === "os-sess-resume-why", "the reason is tied to the button for a screen reader", await resumeButton.getAttribute("aria-describedby"));
      await shot(tab, "sessions", W, H, "resume-blocked");

      // Stop the second one: two ended Codex sessions share the folder, so Agent OS can't tell which to resume.
      await tabNamed(tab, "Codex · shared").click();
      check(await stopSelected(tab, "Codex · shared"), "the second Codex session ended", await selectedTab(tab).textContent());
      check(sessionParam(tab) === secondId, "the second (just ended) tab is the one shown", sessionParam(tab));
      check(await waitFor(async () => await resumeButton.isDisabled(), 8000), "two ended Codex sessions in one folder: Resume conversation is off");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await whyText()) === TWO_ENDED, 8000), `the panel says: ${TWO_ENDED}`, await whyText());
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "console clean (fallback resume)", errors.join(" / "));
      await context.close();
      // Out of the way of the next sections, which count tabs.
      for (const sessionId of [firstId, secondId]) if (sessionId) await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${sessionId}/dismiss`);
    }

    // 8. Look only while sessions are open (Review Focus 5, ruling R28). The harness locks the gate on, so the gate's
    //    answer reads Look only here, and the server's own Look only refusals (409 execution_gate_off for a start and
    //    a resume; Tasks S6 and S8 test them for real) are played back. The open session, its typing and its Stop
    //    are real: Look only stops nothing.
    {
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "sessions");
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1000);
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).click();
      const openId = await startThroughDialog(tab, "Claude Code", myApp);
      await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(BANNER), 15000);
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).click();
      const endedId = await startThroughDialog(tab, "Claude Code", notes);
      await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(BANNER), 15000);
      check(Boolean(openId) && Boolean(endedId) && openId !== endedId, "Look only setup: two sessions", `${openId} ${endedId}`);
      check(await stopSelected(tab, "Claude Code · notes"), "Look only setup: one of them ended, to resume later");

      // Safety switches to Look only.
      const isList = (u) => u.pathname === "/api/sessions";
      const resumeUrl = `**/api/sessions/${endedId}/resume`;
      await tab.route("**/api/execution-gate", (route) => (route.request().method() === "GET" ? json(route, LOOK_ONLY_GATE) : route.continue()));
      await tab.route(isList, (route) => (route.request().method() === "POST" ? json(route, { error: "execution_gate_off", message: LOOK_ONLY }, 409) : route.continue()));
      await tab.route(resumeUrl, (route) => json(route, { error: "execution_gate_off", message: LOOK_ONLY }, 409));

      // The open session keeps running and still takes typing.
      await tabNamed(tab, "Claude Code · my-app").click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(BANNER), 10000), "Look only: the open session's screen comes back when its tab is picked");
      await tab.locator(".os-sess-term .xterm").click();
      await tab.keyboard.type("still here");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes("you said: still here")), "Look only: the open session keeps running and takes typing", (await termText(tab)).slice(-160));
      check(!/Ended/.test((await selectedTab(tab).textContent()) || ""), "Look only: the open tab is not ended");

      // New session: the Look only note replaces the form (decision Q14), with a way to Safety.
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).click();
      let dialog = dialogNamed(tab, "New session");
      check(await waitFor(async () => await dialog.getByText(LOOK_ONLY).isVisible(), 8000), "Look only: New session shows the decided note");
      check(await dialog.getByRole("link", { name: "Open Safety" }).isVisible(), "Look only: a link to Safety");
      check((await dialog.getByRole("radiogroup").count()) === 0 && (await dialog.getByLabel("Folder (full path)").count()) === 0, "Look only: the note replaces the agent and folder fields");
      check(await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Start session" }).isDisabled(), "Look only: Start session stays off");
      await shot(tab, "sessions", W, H, "dialog-look-only");
      await dialog.getByRole("link", { name: "Open Safety" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("page") === "safety", 3000), "Look only: Open Safety goes to Safety", tab.url());
      check((await dialogNamed(tab, "New session").count()) === 0, "and the dialog closes");

      // Resume of the ended tab: refused with the Look only sentence and a way to Safety; the tab stays ended.
      await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=sessions&session=${endedId}`);
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
      const panel = tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Session details" });
      await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" }).click();
      const resume = dialogNamed(tab, "Resume Claude Code · notes?");
      await resume.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => await resume.getByText(LOOK_ONLY).isVisible(), 5000), "Look only: Resume is refused with the Look only sentence");
      check(await resume.getByRole("button", { name: "Open Safety" }).isVisible(), "Look only: a way to Safety from Resume");
      await shot(tab, "sessions", W, H, "resume-look-only");
      await resume.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
      check(/Ended/.test((await selectedTab(tab).textContent()) || ""), "Look only: the ended tab stays ended");

      // A start the server refuses at Look only (the level changed after the dialog read it): the same sentence, a
      // way to Safety, and the typed folder kept.
      await tab.unroute("**/api/execution-gate");
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).click();
      dialog = dialogNamed(tab, "New session");
      await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.getByText("Checking your agents and safety level…").count()) === 0, 15000);
      await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: "Claude Code", exact: true }).click();
      await dialog.getByLabel("Folder (full path)").fill(notes);
      await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Start session" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => await dialog.getByText(LOOK_ONLY).isVisible(), 8000), "a start refused at Look only says so");
      check(await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Open Safety" }).isVisible(), "with a way to Safety");
      check((await dialog.getByLabel("Folder (full path)").inputValue()) === notes, "and the typed folder stays");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");

      // The open session can still be stopped at Look only.
      await tabNamed(tab, "Claude Code · my-app").click();
      check(await stopSelected(tab, "Claude Code · my-app"), "Look only: Stop still ends an open session");
      await tab.unroute(isList);
      await tab.unroute(resumeUrl);
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "console clean (Look only)", errors.join(" / "));
      await context.close();
      // Out of the way of the next sections, which count tabs.
      for (const sessionId of [openId, endedId]) await api("POST", `/api/sessions/${sessionId}/dismiss`);
    }

    // 9. What the fakes cannot produce: no terminal module, the login-shell notice.
    {
      const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "sessions");
      const listUrl = (u) => u.pathname === "/api/sessions";
      await tab.route(listUrl, async (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() !== "GET") return route.continue();
        const res = await route.fetch();
        const body = await res.json();
        return route.fulfill({
          response: res,
          json: { ...body, pty: { ok: false, reason: "Agent OS could not load its terminal module on this computer, so sessions can't start." }, environmentNotice: "Agent OS could not read your login shell's settings, so sessions use a basic environment." }
        });
      });
      await tab.reload();
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
      check(await tab.getByText("Agent OS could not read your login shell's settings, so sessions use a basic environment.").isVisible(), "the login-shell notice, one quiet line");
      check(await tab.getByText("Sessions can't start on this computer").first().isVisible(), "no terminal module: said on the page");
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).click();
      const d2 = dialogNamed(tab, "New session");
      check(await waitFor(async () => await d2.getByText("Sessions can't start on this computer").isVisible(), 8000), "no terminal module: said in the dialog");
      await d2.getByLabel("Folder (full path)").fill(myApp);
      check(await d2.getByRole("button", { name: "Start session" }).isDisabled(), "no terminal module: Start session stays off");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
      await tab.unroute(listUrl);
      await context.close();
    }

    // 10. The desktop app (?desktop=1, a Mac here): the folder picker falls back to a typed path (no Tauri in a
    //     browser), two sessions, the shortcut hints, ⌘1 and ⌘T, ⌘K inside a terminal, a copied link, and Terminal
    //     settings.
    {
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "sessions&desktop=1");
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1000);
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).click();
      let dialog = dialogNamed(tab, "New session");
      check(await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Choose folder…" }).isVisible(), "desktop: Choose folder…");
      await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Choose folder…" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => await dialog.getByLabel("Folder (full path)").isVisible(), 5000), "no native picker here: the dialog offers a typed path instead");
      check(await dialog.getByText("The folder picker didn't open. Type the folder's full path instead.").isVisible(), "and says why");
      const id1 = await startThroughDialog(tab, "Claude Code", myApp);
      await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(BANNER), 15000);
      await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).click();
      dialog = dialogNamed(tab, "New session");
      await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Choose folder…" }).click();
      await waitFor(async () => await dialog.getByLabel("Folder (full path)").isVisible(), 5000);
      const id2 = await startThroughDialog(tab, "Codex", notes);
      check(Boolean(id1) && Boolean(id2) && id1 !== id2, "two sessions", `${id1} ${id2}`);
      await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(BANNER), 15000);
      const keys = (await tab.locator(".os-sess-keys").textContent()) || "";
      check(/⌘T/.test(keys) && /new/.test(keys) && /⌘1-9/.test(keys) && /switch/.test(keys), "desktop on a Mac: ⌘T new and ⌘1-9 switch", keys);
      check(!keys.includes("\\"), "no split hint (split view is SP4)", keys);
      await tab.locator(".os-sess-term .xterm").click();
      await tab.keyboard.press("Meta+1");
      check(await waitFor(async () => sessionParam(tab) === id1, 3000), "⌘1 picks the first tab", sessionParam(tab));
      await tab.keyboard.press("Meta+t");
      check(await waitFor(async () => await dialogNamed(tab, "New session").isVisible(), 3000), "⌘T opens New session");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
      await tab.locator(".os-sess-term .xterm").click();
      await tab.keyboard.press("Meta+k");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await tab.locator('[role="dialog"][aria-label="Command palette"]').count()) === 1, 3000), "(Tasks U1/U2) ⌘K inside a terminal opens the palette");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");

      // A link in the terminal: a browser has no desktop opener, so the address is copied and the page shows the
      // terminal's sentence (ruling R25; the copying is Task U2's, the sentence on the page is this task's).
      await context.grantPermissions(["clipboard-read", "clipboard-write"], { origin: BASE });
      await tab.locator(".os-sess-term .xterm").click();
      await tab.keyboard.type(LINK);
      await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
      await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes(`you said: ${LINK}`), 5000);
      const spot = await tab.evaluate((url) => {
        const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll(".os-sess-term .xterm-rows > div")].reverse();
        for (const row of rows) {
          const at = (row.textContent || "").indexOf(url);
          if (at < 0) continue;
          const nodes = [];
          const walker = document.createTreeWalker(row, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
          for (let n = walker.nextNode(); n; n = walker.nextNode()) nodes.push(n);
          const place = (offset) => {
            let left = offset;
            for (const n of nodes) {
              if (left <= n.textContent.length) return [n, left];
              left -= n.textContent.length;
            }
            return null;
          };
          const from = place(at + 2);
          const to = place(at + url.length - 2);
          if (!from || !to) return null;
          const range = document.createRange();
          range.setStart(from[0], from[1]);
          range.setEnd(to[0], to[1]);
          const box = range.getBoundingClientRect();
          return { x: box.left + box.width / 2, y: box.top + box.height / 2 };
        }
        return null;
      }, LINK);
      if (spot) {
        await tab.mouse.move(spot.x, spot.y);
        await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
        await tab.mouse.click(spot.x, spot.y);
      }
      check(await waitFor(async () => await tab.getByText("Link copied. Open it in your browser.").isVisible(), 5000), "(Task U2) a terminal link is copied in the desktop app, and the page says: Link copied. Open it in your browser.", spot ? "no sentence on the page" : "the link was not found on screen");

      // Terminal settings.
      const settings = tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Terminal settings" });
      await settings.click();
      const menu = tab.getByRole("menu", { name: "Terminal settings" });
      check(await menu.isVisible(), "Terminal settings opens a menu");
      const items = menu.getByRole("menuitemcheckbox");
      check((await items.count()) === 3, "three settings", await items.count());
      const itemText = (await items.allTextContents()).join(" | ");
      for (const words of ["Kitty keyboard (turn off if typing in your language misbehaves)", "Faster drawing (WebGL)", "Use Claude Code's fullscreen view in Agent OS (recommended)", "Applies to new sessions"]) check(itemText.includes(words), `menu words: ${words}`, itemText);
      check(await tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.getAttribute("role") === "menuitemcheckbox"), "focus moves into the menu");
      check((await items.nth(1).getAttribute("aria-checked")) === "false", "on a Mac, Faster drawing (WebGL) is off by default (decision Q45)");
      const fullscreen = items.nth(2);
      await waitFor(async () => (await fullscreen.getAttribute("aria-disabled")) !== "true", 8000);
      const before = await fullscreen.getAttribute("aria-checked");
      await tab.keyboard.press("ArrowDown");
      await tab.keyboard.press("ArrowDown");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await fullscreen.getAttribute("aria-checked")) !== before && (await fullscreen.getAttribute("aria-disabled")) !== "true", 8000), "the fullscreen setting changes and Agent OS keeps it");
      await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
      check((await menu.count()) === 0, "Escape closes the menu");
      check(/Terminal settings/.test(await focusText(tab)), "focus goes back to Terminal settings", await focusText(tab));
      await settings.click();
      const reopened = tab.getByRole("menu", { name: "Terminal settings" }).getByRole("menuitemcheckbox");
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await reopened.nth(2).getAttribute("aria-disabled")) !== "true" && (await reopened.nth(2).getAttribute("aria-checked")) !== before, 8000), "reopening reads the kept setting back");
      await reopened.nth(2).click();
      await waitFor(async () => (await reopened.nth(2).getAttribute("aria-checked")) === before && (await reopened.nth(2).getAttribute("aria-disabled")) !== "true", 8000);
      await reopened.nth(0).click();
      check(/"kittyKeyboard":false/.test((await tab.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem("agentos.terminalPrefs"))) || ""), "kitty keyboard is kept in this browser");
      await reopened.nth(0).click();
      await tab.mouse.click(700, 500);
      check((await tab.getByRole("menu", { name: "Terminal settings" }).count()) === 0, "a click outside closes the menu");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "console clean (desktop)", errors.join(" / "));
      await shot(tab, "sessions", W, H, "two-sessions");
      await context.close();
    }

    // 11. Layout with two live sessions: 304 px panel at ≤ 1320 px, Stop and New session on screen, no sideways scroll.
    for (const [w, h] of [[1280, 720], [1024, 640], [1512, 982]]) {
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, w, h, "sessions");
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1800);
      check(!(await sideways(tab)), `${w}x${h}: no sideways scroll`);
      const panelBox = await tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Session details" }).boundingBox();
      if (w <= 1320) check(Boolean(panelBox) && Math.round(panelBox.width) === 304, `${w}: panel is 304 px`, JSON.stringify(panelBox));
      const stopBox = await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Stop session" }).boundingBox();
      check(Boolean(stopBox) && stopBox.y >= 0 && stopBox.y + stopBox.height <= h, `${w}x${h}: Stop session is on screen`, JSON.stringify(stopBox));
      const newBox = await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).boundingBox();
      check(Boolean(newBox) && newBox.y >= 0 && newBox.y + newBox.height <= h, `${w}x${h}: New session is on screen`, JSON.stringify(newBox));
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, `${w}x${h}: console clean`, errors.join(" / "));
      await shot(tab, "sessions", w, h, "two-sessions");
      await context.close();
    }

    // 12. Agent OS goes away: the tabs stay under a warn note, and the page comes back by itself.
    {
      const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "sessions");
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
      const listUrl = (u) => u.pathname === "/api/sessions";
      await tab.route(listUrl, (route) => route.abort());
      check(await waitFor(async () => await tab.getByText("Can't reach Agent OS").first().isVisible(), 20000), "a failed refresh shows Can't reach Agent OS");
      check((await tab.locator('.os-sess-tabs [role="tab"]').count()) >= 2, "the last known tabs stay");
      await tab.unroute(listUrl);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await tab.getByText("Can't reach Agent OS").count()) === 0, 15000), "it recovers by itself");
      await context.close();
    }
  } finally {
    // Leave nothing running, even when a section above threw: every session this probe started is stopped.
    await stopEverything().catch(() => undefined);
  }
  const left = await api("GET", "/api/sessions?kind=all");
  check((left.json.sessions || []).every((s) => s.status === "exited"), "the probe leaves no session running", JSON.stringify((left.json.sessions || []).map((s) => s.status)));
}
```

#### Notes

1. **Look only in the probe is stubbed.** The audit harness starts its server with `HERMES_AGENT_OS_ENABLE_EXEC=1`, which locks the gate on, so section 8 plays back the gate's Look only answer and the server's 409 `execution_gate_off` for a start and a resume. The engine's side of Review Focus 5 (create and resume refused, an open session keeps running, Stop, list and Dismiss still work) is Task S6's test; the Safety words are Task U4's. The open session, its typing and its Stop in section 8 are real.
2. **Copy this task adds that the decisions do not list (E1 review, decision Q32):** the ended view "This session has ended" with the panel's line; the caption "<Agent>'s own terminal program, with your own settings."; "Sessions aren't available here" and its body; "Sessions can't start on this computer" (with the server's terminal-module reason); the settings menu's "Couldn't read this setting. Close the menu and open it again to try again." and "Agent OS didn't confirm the change. The box shows what it has kept."; in the dialog the prototype's lede "The agent opens in its own terminal inside Agent OS.", "No folder chosen yet", "A folder inside your home folder.", "The folder picker didn't open. Type the folder's full path instead.", "Inside the folder, <agent> asks for its own permissions, the same as in your own terminal.", "Checking your agents and safety level…" and the start-without-answer sentence (`START_NO_ANSWER`); the words in `actionProblem`. The empty state has no lede under its h1 (the decided body says it all).
3. **Live meter rows per brain.** The spec lists "Plan used" for plan brains and "Cost so far" for OpenRouter brains without saying what a Local brain or an agent with no brain choice (`brain: null`) shows. This task shows neither row for those, and Brain "—" for `null`.
4. **The OpenClaw stop note is repeated for a tab opened later.** Right after a Stop from this page, the panel shows the server's own `note` (S7's answer, null included), kept with the terminal key of the run that was stopped (`panelStopNote`). An ended OpenClaw tab opened later (after a reload, or stopped from another window) has no answer to read, so `stopResultNote` repeats S7's rule (`agentId === "openclaw"` and `endedBy === "stop"`); when spike S5 brings the Gateway abort, both change together (S7 note 2).
5. **Deliberate limits.** ⌘T and ⌘1-9 work only while the Sessions page is shown (the hints are shown only there too). Kitty keyboard and Faster drawing are kept in this browser only (spec, Browser terminal), so the desktop app and a browser tab can differ. A Dismiss kept across a server restart is Tasks S6 and S8's test; the probe checks a page reload. The terminal-link check in section 10 depends on Task U2's copying and the browser's clipboard permission; the sentence on the page is this task's. Only the selected tab's terminal is attached; every other live session keeps running in the engine and attaches, with a fresh snapshot of its screen and modes, when its tab is picked. The spec's "Reopening attaches every live session" is therefore met one tab at a time (the restored screen is the same; SP3 shows no alerts, the mirror answers terminal queries for a session with no window, and the PTY never pauses with no window). List this in E1's report of deliberate differences from the spec, and revisit it in SP4 when alerts arrive.

### Task U4: Home New session and Orbit, Agents Open/New session and "What works here", Runs Session recordings, Safety link, Help page

This task lets sessions show up everywhere outside the Sessions page, as the spec's "Also in SP3" asks. **Home** gets its primary "New session" button (the same dialog as Task U3), and the Orbit, the agent table, the lede and Recent activity count sessions: a line lights only while a session (or a run) is live, while starting, idle and ended sessions stay dim (spec L439). **Agents** gets "Open session" (when that agent has an open session) or "New session" in the agent's header, and the one honest note "What works here" (H8). **Runs → Session recordings** lists every recording: a live one offers "Open live session", an ended one "Resume conversation" (or says why it can't; at Look only the refusal says so and offers Safety) with the note "Replay arrives in a later update", an update recording reads "<agent> update", the 1 GB cap note shows when older recordings were removed, "Open recording" from an ended Sessions tab lands on its row, highlighted, and where sessions do not run the tab says so instead of "isn't responding". **Safety** gets the link "How stopping works", and its level words and its "Turn on Run agents?" question say where a session starts and that Look only starts none (Review Focus 5). The new **Help page** (`?page=help`, not in the menu) is `prototype/how-it-works.html` with only what is true in SP3.

Why it is built this way, in plain words: everything reads the one shared sessions poll (`useSessionsList`, decision Q30), so Home, Agents and Runs agree with the Sessions page and the menu; the Help page's words about closing the window come from one small pure function, because closing the window hides it on a Mac, quits after asking on Windows and Linux, and only closes the page in a browser tab; and every new piece of copy is either a decided string or checked by a test that forbids SP4 promises.

- [ ] **Step 5: Write `src/ui/recordingsShared.ts`.**

```ts
// Runs → Session recordings: the pure logic. The rows come from GET /api/recordings, checked here (an answer that is
// not a list is no answer), and are joined with the shared sessions list for Resume. No imports at all, so
// test/recordings-help-logic.test.js loads it straight from src/. durationWords is a copy of the one in
// sessionsPageShared.ts (Node cannot follow an import written without a file extension); that test checks they agree.
// A row's title is Task U1's sessionTitle (sessionsShared.ts), used by the component.

export interface RecordingRow {
  sessionId: string;
  kind: "agent" | "update";
  agentId: string;
  agentLabel: string;
  folder: string;
  folderName: string;
  folderShown: boolean;
  startedAt: string;
  endedAt: string | null;
  bytes: number | null;
  live: boolean;
}
export interface RecordingsBody {
  rows: RecordingRow[];
  // How many ended recordings were deleted to stay under 1 GB since Agent OS started (decision Q38; the route's
  // `removedByCap`).
  removedByCap: number;
}

// Decided words (decision Q38 and the Session recordings copy, Q32, owner). The recording holds output only, but an
// agent echoes what you type, so typed text that appears on screen (a pasted secret too) is in the recording.
export const REPLAY_LATER = "Replay arrives in a later update";
export const CAP_NOTE = "Older recordings were removed to stay under 1 GB.";
export const EMPTY_TITLE = "No recordings yet";
export const EMPTY_BODY = "Every session is recorded here: what its terminal showed, including anything you typed that appeared on screen.";

const text = (value: unknown): string => (typeof value === "string" ? value : "");
const startMs = (iso: string): number => {
  const ms = Date.parse(iso);
  return Number.isFinite(ms) ? ms : 0;
};
const count = (value: unknown): number => (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : 0);

// The answer of GET /api/recordings, checked: `{ recordings: [...], removedByCap }`, or a bare list. A row with no
// session id is dropped; a missing kind is an agent session; a missing folderShown shows the folder. Newest first.
export function readRecordings(answer: unknown): RecordingsBody | null {
  const body = answer && typeof answer === "object" && !Array.isArray(answer) ? (answer as Record<string, unknown>) : null;
  const list = Array.isArray(answer) ? answer : body && Array.isArray(body.recordings) ? (body.recordings as unknown[]) : null;
  if (!list) return null;
  const rows: RecordingRow[] = [];
  for (const item of list) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object") continue;
    const r = item as Record<string, unknown>;
    const sessionId = text(r.sessionId);
    if (!sessionId) continue;
    rows.push({
      sessionId,
      kind: r.kind === "update" ? "update" : "agent",
      agentId: text(r.agentId),
      agentLabel: text(r.agentLabel) || text(r.agentId) || "—",
      folder: text(r.folder),
      folderName: text(r.folderName),
      folderShown: r.folderShown !== false,
      startedAt: text(r.startedAt),
      endedAt: text(r.endedAt) || null,
      bytes: typeof r.bytes === "number" && Number.isFinite(r.bytes) ? r.bytes : null,
      live: r.live === true
    });
  }
  rows.sort((a, b) => startMs(b.startedAt) - startMs(a.startedAt));
  const removed = body ? count(body.removedByCap) : 0;
  return { rows, removedByCap: removed };
}

export type RowAction = { kind: "open" } | { kind: "resume"; available: boolean; reason: string } | { kind: "none" };
type SessionView = { status: string; resume?: { available: boolean; reason: string | null } | null };

// What a row offers. An update recording offers nothing (it is never resumed, spec Session kinds). The sessions list
// is the newer word on whether a session runs (the recording's own flag can be a poll behind): an open session opens;
// an ended one resumes, or says why it can't (the server's reason, decision Q36, worded as Task U1's Resume confirm
// does). "…" while the list is loading.
export function rowAction(row: Pick<RecordingRow, "kind" | "live">, session: SessionView | undefined, sessionsState: "loading" | "ok" | "error"): RowAction {
  if (row.kind === "update") return { kind: "none" };
  const live = session ? session.status !== "exited" : row.live;
  if (live) return { kind: "open" };
  if (!session) {
    if (sessionsState === "loading") return { kind: "resume", available: false, reason: "…" };
    if (sessionsState === "error") return { kind: "resume", available: false, reason: "Agent OS can't check this conversation right now." };
    return { kind: "resume", available: false, reason: "This session can't be resumed." };
  }
  if (session.resume?.available) return { kind: "resume", available: true, reason: "" };
  return { kind: "resume", available: false, reason: session.resume?.reason || "This session can't be resumed." };
}

// "40 s", "12 m 40 s", "1 h 05 m"; "—" when the start is not known (or lies in the future). A copy of
// sessionsPageShared.ts's durationWords, checked by test/recordings-help-logic.test.js.
export function durationWords(fromIso: string | null | undefined, toMs: number): string {
  const from = fromIso ? Date.parse(fromIso) : NaN;
  if (!Number.isFinite(from) || !Number.isFinite(toMs) || toMs < from) return "—";
  const seconds = Math.floor((toMs - from) / 1000);
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds} s`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes} m ${String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, "0")} s`;
  return `${Math.floor(minutes / 60)} h ${String(minutes % 60).padStart(2, "0")} m`;
}

// How long a recording runs: "so far" while it is live; "—" when an ended one has no end time.
export function recordingLength(row: Pick<RecordingRow, "startedAt" | "endedAt" | "live">, now: number): { value: string; soFar: boolean } {
  if (row.live) return { value: durationWords(row.startedAt, now), soFar: true };
  const end = row.endedAt ? Date.parse(row.endedAt) : NaN;
  return { value: Number.isFinite(end) ? durationWords(row.startedAt, end) : "—", soFar: false };
}
```

export const ROUTE_QUIET = "Everything on this diagram runs on your computer";

export const PROMISES: Array<{ id: "stop" | "flags" | "answers"; title: string; body: string }> = [
  {
    id: "stop",
    title: "Stop ends the agent and what runs under it",
    body:

A Claude Code background task moved with /bg may keep running if Agent OS can't find it, and OpenClaw may still finish its last step after the terminal closes. The Hermes background service and the OpenClaw Gateway keep running: each has its own Stop on Agents."
  },
  {
    id: "flags",
    title: "No skip-permissions flags, ever",
    body: "Some agents have a launch option that switches off their safety questions. Agent OS never starts an agent with it, and no setting can turn it on."
  },
  {
    id: "answers",
    title: "Nothing answers for you",
    body: "Agent OS never answers an agent's question for you. You read it and press the key yourself."
  }
];

export const GLOSSARY: Array<{ term: string; text: string }> = [
  { term: "Pseudo-terminal", text: "A pretend keyboard and screen the engine gives the agent, so the agent behaves as if you typed in an ordinary terminal." },
  { term: "WebSocket", text: "A two-way line between two programs that stays open, so the screen can update the instant the agent draws." },
  { term: "Recording", text: "What the terminal showed, saved on this computer as it happens, including anything you typed that appeared on screen." }
];

export interface LifeStep {
  id: "close" | "reopen" | "quit" | "resume";
  title: string;
  body: string;
}
export interface LifeSection {
  title: string;
  quiet: string;
  // The engine's second line in the diagram.
  engineNote: string;
  // The prototype's timeline (a closed window while the sessions run) is true only where closing hides the window.
  timeline: boolean;
  steps: LifeStep[];
}

const RESUME: LifeStep = {
  id: "resume",
  title: "Resume later",
  body: "Press Resume conversation on the ended tab or in Runs. The agent's own resume feature picks the conversation up again."
};

export function lifeSection({ desktop, isMac }: { desktop: boolean; isMac: boolean }): LifeSection {
  if (desktop && isMac) {
    return {
      title: "Close the window, and nothing stops",
      quiet: "Because the engine owns the sessions, not the window",
      engineNote: "Keeps running if you close the window",
      timeline: true,
      steps: [
        { id: "close", title: "Close the window", body: "Sessions keep running. The engine owns them, so closing a window ends nothing." },
        { id: "reopen", title: "Reopen", body: "The screen is restored at once, because the engine kept an invisible copy of it." },
        // Only ⌘Q and the Quit menu item can ask: the Dock's Quit, the app switcher's Quit and logging out end the
        // sessions without the question (decision Q5b, ruling R19).
        { id: "quit", title: "Quit Agent OS", body: "With ⌘Q or the Quit menu item, Agent OS asks first while sessions run. If you go ahead, it ends them." },
        RESUME
      ]
    };
  }
  if (desktop) {
    // Decision copy for Windows and Linux, step 1. The other steps say what really follows a quit.
    return {
      title: "Closing the window quits Agent OS",
      quiet: "On Windows and Linux, closing the window is how you quit",
      engineNote: "Runs while Agent OS is open",
      timeline: false,
      steps: [
        { id: "close", title: "Close the window", body: "Agent OS asks first, then quits and ends your sessions." },
        { id: "reopen", title: "Open Agent OS again", body: "Sessions that ended when Agent OS quit come back as ended tabs. Their recordings stay in Runs." },
        RESUME
      ]
    };
  }
  return {
    title: "Close this tab, and nothing stops",
    quiet: "Because the engine owns the sessions, not the page",
    engineNote: "Keeps running if you close this tab",
    timeline: false,
    steps: [
      { id: "close", title: "Close this tab", body: "Sessions keep running. The engine owns them, so closing a tab ends nothing." },
      { id: "reopen", title: "Open it again", body: "The screen is restored at once, because the engine kept an invisible copy of it." },
      { id: "quit", title: "Stop Agent OS", body: "When the Agent OS program stops, it ends the running sessions first." },
      RESUME
    ]
  };
}

- [ ] **Step 7: Teach Home's logic about sessions.** In `src/ui/homeShared.ts`:

1. Replace `import type { AgentSummary, RunMeta } from "../types";` with `import type { AgentSummary, RunMeta, SessionSummary } from "../types";`.

2. Replace the `orbitStates` block (the comment `// A line lights only while that agent works. "waiting" (amber) arrives with SP4.` and the function under it) with:

```ts
// A line lights only while that agent works: a live agent run, or a session whose state is live (spec: Home Orbit is
// lit only while live; starting, idle, held and exited stay dim). An update session never shows on Home. "waiting"
// (amber) arrives with SP4.
export function orbitStates(runs: RunMeta[], sessions: SessionSummary[] = []): OrbitStates {
  const out: OrbitStates = {};
  for (const id of Object.keys(liveRunsByAgent(runs)) as HomeAgentId[]) out[id] = "live";
  for (const session of sessions) {
    if (session.kind !== "update" && session.status === "live" && isHomeAgent(session.agentId)) out[session.agentId] = "live";
  }
  return out;
}

// Open agent sessions: every one that has not ended. (Update sessions are never counted on Home, spec Session kinds.)
export function openSessions(sessions: SessionSummary[]): SessionSummary[] {
  return sessions.filter((session) => session.kind !== "update" && session.status !== "exited");
}

// Each agent's newest open session.
export function openSessionByAgent(sessions: SessionSummary[]): Partial<Record<string, SessionSummary>> {
  const out: Partial<Record<string, SessionSummary>> = {};
  for (const session of openSessions(sessions)) {
    const before = out[session.agentId];
    if (!before || Date.parse(session.startedAt) > Date.parse(before.startedAt)) out[session.agentId] = session;
  }
  return out;
}

// Home's view of the shared sessions list (useSessionsList): only the sessions, as a Source. Where sessions do not
// run (the public demo, a shared server) there are none, which is true, not unknown.
export function sessionsSource(source: Source<{ sessions: SessionSummary[] }>, available: boolean): Source<SessionSummary[]> {
  if (!available) return loaded([]);
  if (source.state !== "ok") return source;
  const list = Array.isArray(source.data?.sessions) ? source.data.sessions : [];
  return source.stale ? { state: "ok", data: list, stale: true } : { state: "ok", data: list };
}
```

3. Replace the whole `agentLine` function (from `export function agentLine(input: {` to its closing `}`) with:

```ts
export function agentLine(input: {
  agents: "loading" | "ok" | "error";
  // The runs list: until it has loaded, Home can't say what an agent is doing.
  runs: "loading" | "ok" | "error";
  // The shared sessions list (SP3). Left out, it counts as loaded with no session for this agent.
  sessions?: "loading" | "ok" | "error";
  summary?: AgentSummary;
  live?: RunMeta;
  last?: RunMeta;
  // This agent's newest open session (openSessionByAgent).
  session?: SessionSummary;
  now: number;
}): AgentLine {
  if (input.agents === "loading") return { state: "loading", where: "" };
  if (input.agents === "error") return { state: "unknown", where: "Can't reach Agent OS" };
  if (!input.summary?.detected.installed) return { state: "unknown", label: "Not installed", where: "Install it from Setup" };
  if (input.runs === "loading") return { state: "loading", where: "" };
  if (input.runs === "error") return { state: "unknown", where: "Can't tell if it's working" };
  if (input.live) {
    // The elapsed time comes first, so a long task is what the cell cuts off, and
    // the line never starts or ends with a bare separator.
    const task = [input.live.task?.line, input.live.title].map((text) => (text || "").trim()).find(Boolean) ?? "";
    const elapsed = elapsedLabel(input.live.startedAt || input.live.createdAt, input.now);
    return { state: "live", where: [elapsed === "—" ? "" : elapsed, task].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") };
  }
  // Until the sessions list is known, "Nothing running" could be false.
  const sessions = input.sessions ?? "ok";
  if (sessions === "loading") return { state: "loading", where: "" };
  if (sessions === "error") return { state: "unknown", where: "Can't tell if it's working" };
  if (input.session) {
    const where = input.session.folderShown === false ? "Session open" : `Session in ${input.session.folderName}`;
    if (input.session.status === "live") return { state: "live", where };
    // Ruling R26 (decision Q18): Starting is the idle icon with the word "Starting", never "working".
    if (input.session.status === "starting") return { state: "idle", label: "Starting", where };
    return { state: "idle", where };
  }
  const last = input.last;
  if (last && last.limit && !last.continuedBy && !ACTIVE.has(last.status)) return { state: "held", where: "Plan limit reached" };
  return { state: "ready", where: "Nothing running" };
}
```
